description: This file is a shell script for orchestrating build, patching, and testing workflows for a software project involving multiple components such as Thunder, ThunderTools, entservices-apis, googletest, and entservices-appgateway. It manages cloning repositories, applying patches, configuring build environments, building components with CMake, copying plugins, and running unit tests with coverage analysis.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Outputs a message with a prefix indicating normal logging.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Outputs a warning message to standard error.

methods.name: err
methods.description: Outputs an error message to standard error.

methods.name: have_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command exists in the system PATH.

methods.name: is_root
methods.description: Checks if the current user has root privileges.

methods.name: apt_can_run
methods.description: Determines if apt-get commands can be executed (checking for root or sudo).

methods.name: apt_get
methods.description: Runs apt-get commands with proper privileges, handling whether the user is root or not.

methods.name: run_best_effort
methods.description: Runs a command, logs a warning if it fails, but does not terminate the script.

methods.name: git_noninteractive_env
methods.description: Sets environment variables for non-interactive Git commands.

methods.name: ensure_git_checkout_ref
methods.description: Checks out a specific Git reference in a repository directory.

methods.name: ensure_repo_clone_and_checkout
methods.description: Clones a repository if not present or reclones if forced, then checks out a specified reference.

methods.name: apply_patch_dir
methods.description: Applies a patch to a repository directory idempotently.

methods.name: build_dir_configured
methods.description: Checks if the build directory has been configured by verifying the presence of CMakeCache.txt.

methods.name: is_component_installed
methods.description: Heuristically determines if a component is installed based on directory contents.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_install
methods.description: Configures, builds, and installs a component using CMake, if not already configured.
